summary: You can follow a policy change from save to applied on one page.

new.title: Follow a policy change on one page
new.text: When you save policy choices, PIM Manager plans the change at once and shows each step on the same page: planning, waiting for Approve all, approved and applied.

fixes.title: Approvals always shows policy changes
fixes.text: The Approvals page now always includes its policy part.

fixes.title: Clearer Overview and save messages
fixes.text: The Overview gap tile uses the coverage check, waiting policy choices show as an info line, and the save message no longer sounds like the second-approver setting.

fixes.title: No false updater error
fixes.text: The updater no longer logs an error for a database user that already exists.
